{"id":1584480383,"question_id":3430,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1742826625,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"74 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1584480383/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Days Without Meetings","memory":"126.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countDays(int days, vector<vector<int>>& meetings) {\n       vector<vector<int>>ans;\n        sort(meetings.begin(), meetings.end());\n        int start = meetings[0][0];\n        int end = meetings[0][1];\n        \n        for(int i = 1 ; i<meetings.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            int left = meetings[i][0];\n            int right = meetings[i][1];\n            //overlapping condition\n            if(end >= left)\n            {\n                end = max(end,right); \n            }\n            else \n            {\n                ans.push_back({start,end});   \n                start = left;\n                end = right;\n            }\n        }\n        ans.push_back({start,end});\n        //counting the non working days\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i = 1  ; i<ans.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            count += ans[i][0] - ans[i-1][1] - 1;\n        }\n        count += days - ans[ans.size()-1][1];\n        count += ans[0][0]-1; \n    return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-days-without-meetings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":495}
